text:
Sam (support): Hey team, AcmeOps reporting intermittent 503s and client-side timeouts on hosted /v1/generate since ~09:10 UTC. They say it mostly happens during our SDK batch-retry path when prompts are ~18k tokens. Customer thread attached below.

AcmeOps (customer): FYI, our users hit a bunch of errors and retries. Sample curl we used: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-2-large","inputs":["<large prompt>"]}'
```
We see 503 or connection reset, then our SDK retries 3x and some requests double-bill.

Sam (support): Customer included this snippet from their client logs: 
```
[2026-03-17T09:11:02Z] request_id=acme-req-42 status=502 upstream=reset
[2026-03-17T09:11:03Z] request_id=acme-req-42 retry=1 status=503 body=\"gateway closed\"
[2026-03-17T09:11:05Z] request_id=acme-req-42 final=timeout
```

Priya (sre): I'm looking at edge telemetry. I can correlate some of Acme's request_ids. Seeing a pattern: keepalive resets + TLS session renegotiation around that time in us-west-2. There are also short bursts of auth token rotate events for that tenant (multiple concurrent tokens). SDK fanout + keepalive churn could be tripping the gateway connection pool.

Elias (infra): Noted. Searching proxy logs for 1748880000..1748880300. I see many connections hitting 502/503 with underlying message: \"upstream prematurely closed connection\" and HTTP/2 stream resets (RST_STREAM 0x1). That often maps to connection reuse issues when backend evicts kvcache or model process OOMs. No full node OOMs reported, but per-host queue lengths spike.

Marta (customer-success): I've told AcmeOps we have engineers triaging and asked for their SDK version and exact retry config. They sent: `redwood-sdk-js@1.4.2` with default retry/backoff.

Priya (sre): Can AcmeOps share request-id for a failing call? I grabbed `acme-req-42` from their logs, matching our traces. Attaching a snippet of our edge trace for that id: 
```
trace_id=tr-7792 tenant=acme start=09:11:01 upstream_conn=alive keepalive_reuse=2 tls_reneg=1 status=503 err=RST_STREAM
```

Elias (infra): As a temporary mitigation I pinned their traffic to host-pool-b (less NAT churn) and lowered per-connection concurrent streams from 100 -> 30 for that pool to reduce head-of-line failures. deploy-bot rolled config change: 
```
deploy-bot: rolled host-pool-b conn-stream-limit=30 route-pin=acme-tenant
```

Sam (support): I communicated the mitigation to the customer. They reported fewer failures after 09:18 UTC but still occasional 503s on long prompts.

AcmeOps (customer): We've seen the rate drop, thanks. Still one or two 503s in the last 20 mins. Can you suggest SDK changes while you dig in?

Priya (sre): Ask them to temporarily reduce SDK concurrency and bump backoff: set max in-flight requests to 4 and exponential backoff start=300ms, max=8s. Also enable idempotency keys for multi-part submissions to avoid double billing on retries.

Marta (customer-success): Sent exact SDK snippet to AcmeOps: 
```
client = new Redwood({ token })
client.config({ maxConcurrent: 4, retry: { minDelayMs: 300, maxDelayMs: 8000 }, idempotency: true })
```

Elias (infra): For next steps on our side: 1) instrument request-level id in proxy logs (we have partials), 2) add guardrails to avoid evicting active kvcache entries during model GC, 3) validate per-host keepalive timeout symmetry between edge and backend. I'll open infra ticket INFRA-8237.

Priya (sre): I'll correlate token-rotation events to tenant fan-out. If token refresh against auth backend spikes, our edge closes/recreates connections which can lead to in-flight stream resets. Action item: SR-429 add grace window on token swap.

Sam (support): Customer update sent at 09:32 UTC: they implemented SDK limits and saw success rate go up from 88% -> 98%. They asked for ETA on permanent fix.

Elias (infra): ETA for first infra changes (pinning improvements + logging) = ~24 hours. Larger GC/kv cache changes might be 3-5 days. Will post INFRA-8237 link when created.

Marta (customer-success): I'll keep AcmeOps on this thread and offer a temporary rate credit if they see any double billing while we fix server-side behavior.

Sam (support): Summary/action items: 
- AcmeOps: keep SDK concurrency reduced, enable idempotency keys (customer confirmed).
- Infra (Elias): create INFRA-8237, improve logging and host pin logic, assess kvcache eviction policy.
- SRE (Priya): add token-rotation grace, correlate auth spikes to stream resets.
- CS (Marta): coordinate customer comms & credits.

I'll update this thread as we roll fixes. :thumbsup:
